page.title: Reader — your saved-link inbox
page.description: Save links from the web. Find them, pull their content, and mark them read through ChatGPT.

hero.title: Save a link. *Pick it up in ChatGPT.*
hero.lede: Keep the pages you want to come back to in one place. Add a URL, or save the current tab with the Chrome extension. ChatGPT can find your links, pull their content, and mark them read when you ask.

window.title: reader / inbox
window.alt: Reader's inbox with six saved links, read-state controls and an add-link button

hero.caption: Illustrative interface · example links, not a customer's inbox

blocks.title: A saved tab is *only an intention.*
blocks.lede: Reader keeps the list small: what you saved, whether you have read it, and a way back to it.

points.title: Save it
points.body: Paste a URL in the inbox, or click Save link in the Chrome extension. Reader stores the title, the address and the date.

points.title: Find it
points.body: Switch between unread, read and all. Search matches titles and addresses.

points.title: Mark it
points.body: Links stay unread until you say otherwise. Opening or fetching a link never marks it read on its own.

blocks.title: Ask about what you saved, *in the conversation you are already in.*
blocks.lede: Reader connects to ChatGPT through MCP with OAuth. Reading and discussion happen there; Reader holds the list.

points.title: Search
points.body: “What have I saved about databases?” finds matching links in your inbox.

points.title: Fetch
points.body: Pulls the available text of a link. If a site blocks extraction, the original address is still there.

points.title: Mark read
points.body: Marks a link read, or unread again, only when you ask. Read and write are separate permissions.

blocks.title: Small on purpose, *and private to your account.*
blocks.lede: Reader is a maintained personal tool. It does one job and does not grow past it.

points.title: Google sign-in
points.body: Your inbox belongs to your account and is isolated from every other.

points.title: Chrome extension
points.body: Saves the active tab's address and title. Built from source for a local unpacked install.

points.title: Not in Reader
points.body: No RSS, annotations, boards, PDF capture or built-in AI. Earlier saves are kept and appear as links.

points.title: No checkout
points.body: There is no public plan or payment.

items.q: How do I add a link?
items.a: Paste a URL in the inbox, or click Save link in the Chrome extension.
Only what its tools ask for: a search over your saved titles and addresses, the text of a link you point it at, and the read state of a link you ask it to change.

items.q: Where did the other features go?
items.a: RSS, the reader view, annotations, boards, memories, PDFs and built-in AI are outside the active product. Existing saved data is retained.

items.q: Can I install the Chrome extension?
items.a: It is built from the repository and loaded unpacked in Chrome. Public store distribution is deferred.

blocks.title: Bring one link you mean *to come back to.*
blocks.lede: Sign in with Google, paste the address, and it is waiting in your inbox.

footer.summary: A maintained saved-link inbox with a Chrome capture extension and ChatGPT access. Personal use, no public checkout.
